### Vessels of God
Author: Rachael Adams
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-april-30.html
Passage: Ephesians 3:20
Points:
- Believers frequently struggle with self-doubt and feeling inadequate in their service.
- God's abundant supply fills empty vessels, much like the widow's oil in 2 Kings.
- Fragile human vessels hold eternal treasure through the indwelling presence of the Holy Spirit.
- Entrusting what little we possess to God allows Him to accomplish immeasurably more than we can ask or imagine.

### Christ in Our Hearts
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/christ-our-hearts
Passage: Ephesians 3:16-17
Points:
- Paul offers intercession to comfort and strengthen believers facing discouragement and trials.
- God grants inner power from His inexhaustible storehouse of divine glory and grace.
- The prayer asks not merely for conversion, but that Christ would feel fully at home in the believer's heart.
- Spiritual growth requires ongoing sanctification and reliance on the Spirit to remain a fit dwelling place for the Lord.
